purpose.zh: 一点点拉开大腿后侧和髋前侧
purpose.en: Gradually stretch the backs of your thighs and the front of your hips.

text.zh: 一手轻扶椅子，前后腿慢慢滑开
text.en: Hold the chair lightly and slowly slide your legs apart

text.zh: 只滑到能控制的地方，髋部朝前。
text.en: Slide only as far as you can control, hips facing forward.

text.zh: 每次呼气再放松一点，别来回颠。
text.en: Each time you breathe out, relax a little deeper. No bouncing.

cautions.zh: 只拉到舒服的程度，疼就放松
cautions.en: Stretch only to a comfortable point, and ease off if anything hurts.

cautions.zh: 用结实、不带轮子的椅子
cautions.en: Use a sturdy chair without wheels.

changes: 动画每 8 秒一次滑开-停 2 s-收回，剂量从 30 秒保持改为每侧 2 组×4 次（rep_hold）
